settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day return policy on all full-price items. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in their original condition with all tags attached. Sale items are final sale.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes — complimentary standard shipping is included on all orders within Australia. Express and international shipping rates are calculated at checkout.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order is dispatched you will receive a tracking link via email. You can also view your order status in your account dashboard.

settings.question: How do I care for my garments?
settings.answer: Each garment includes care instructions on its label. For specific care guidance on luxury pieces, please feel free to contact us directly.

settings.question: Do you offer styling consultations?
settings.answer: Yes — our in-store stylists are available by appointment at all boutique locations. You can also reach out via the contact form to arrange a virtual styling session.
